title: Protocol to detect infectious SARS-CoV-2 at low levels using in situ hybridization techniques
protocol: Seed Vero cells in D10 in a 96-flat well plate for infection the next day.
Perform 10-fold serial dilutions of viral stocks or biological samples in DMEM supplemented with Penicillin/streptomycin (100 U/mL) and 2% FCS.
Infect cells with 50 μL viral dilution for 1–3 h at 37°C.
Replace inoculum with 100 μL fresh pre-warmed D2.
Incubate Vero cells for 24 h at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Wash two times Vero cells with PBS-FISH.
Incubate Vero cells in Trypsin 0.05% v/v solution for 5 min at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Add 100 μL D2 to neutralize trypsin and then transfer cells to a round bottom plate.
Wash the wells of the culture plate with 100 μL PBS and transfer cells to corresponding wells of a round bottom plate.
Centrifuge cells at 300 × g for 10 min and remove media.
Perform viability staining with 50 μL Viobility 405/452 diluted in PBS (final dilution 1:100), 5 min on ice.
Add 200 μL PBS and centrifuge cells at 300 × g for 5 min to remove excess of Viobility staining solution.
Resuspend cell pellets with 4% v/v paraformaldehyde and incubate for 30 min for cell fixation.
Resuspend 10^5 cells in 20 μL of PBS without calcium and magnesium.
Drop the 20 μL of cell suspension on the poly-L-lysine-coated slide.
Deposit a maximum of two to three drops per slide.
Allow drying at 20°C–23°C for 2 h.
Store slides at 4°C until the RNAscope assay is run.
Resuspend cells in solution of primary antibodies diluted in PERM-FISH-Tween or PERM-FISH-Sapo buffer.
Dilute Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-S1 antibody at 1:250 in any perm buffer.
Add 50 μL of diluted antibody solution per well.
Mix the cells.
Incubate for 30 min at 20°C–23°C.
Add 200 μL PERM-FISH-Tween or PERM-FISH-Sapo to the wells.
Wash out PERM-FISH-Tween buffer containing antibody by pelleting down the cells at 300 x g, 5 min, 20°C–23°C.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL HWB.
Pause point: Immunolabeled cells can be stored up to 16–18 h in HWB at 4°C.
Wash out HWB and resuspend immunolabeled cells in HB10%dx buffer containing the combined probe sets.
Mix probes from stock solutions to a final concentration of 50 nM per reaction, using Nuclease-free water as diluent if necessary.
Avoid bubbles when mixing probes with HB10%dx buffer and when mixing cells with the probe-containing solution.
Use 50 μL of HB10%dx buffer containing the probes per reaction.
Distribute samples in a 96-well plate with round bottom.
Gently mix cells and probe-containing solution.
Prepare 10% more volume of HB10%dx buffer containing the probes than actually required for the experiment.
Seal the 96-well plate containing samples with an adhesive film or parafilm.
Incubate at 37°C for 16–18 h.
Incubate samples for up to 16 hours to avoid false positives.
Add 200 μL HWB to each well to wash out the HB10%dx buffer solution containing probes and centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 minutes at 20°C–23°C.
Repeat washing procedure once.
Resuspend cells in PBS without calcium and magnesium.
Proceed with flow cytometry acquisition using Guava 12-HT (Millipore).
Analyze the flow cytometry data using dedicated software such as GuavaSoft 3.4 (Millipore) or FlowJo (BD).
Incubate samples for 24 hours at 37°C.
Label samples for viral RNA and spike protein.
Quantify infection using flow cytometry.
Submerge poly-L-lysine-coated slides containing dried cell suspension spots in 100% ethanol for 1 minute.
Dry the slides at 20°C–23°C.
Boil TRR solution until bubbling starts.
Incubate slides in boiling TRR, reducing heat by 30%, for 30 minutes.
Wash slides in distilled water (dH2O) with up-and-down movements three to five times, changing dH2O each time.
Wash slides in 100% ethanol with two up-and-down movements.
Dry the slides at 20°C–23°C.
Create a hydrophobic barrier around dried cell spots using a hydrophobic pen.
Let the hydrophobic barrier dry for 5 min at 20°C–23°C.
Add drops of Protease Plus solution on dried spots.
Incubate slides at 40°C for 5 min.
Pre-warm the RNAscope SARS-CoV-2 probe at 40°C during this time.
Wash slides in dH2O by performing 3–5 up-and-down movements. Repeat two times by changing the dH2O.
Add drops of pre-warmed RNAscope SARS-CoV-2 probe on dried spots.
Incubate slides in a humidified chamber at 40°C for 2 h.
Prepare the RWB and keep it at 37°C during this time.
Wash slides by submerging them for 2 min in warmed RWB. Repeat one time by changing the RWB.
Add drops of AMP1 on dried cell spots.
Incubate slides in a humidified chamber at 40°C for 30 min.
Wash slides by submerging them for 2 min in warmed RWB. Repeat one time by changing the RWB.
Add drops of AMP2 on dried cell spots.
Incubate slides in a humidified chamber at 40°C for 30 min.
Wash slides by submerging them for 2 min in warmed RWB. Repeat one time by changing the RWB.
Add drops of AMP3 on dried cell spots.
Incubate slides in a humidified chamber at 40°C for 15 min.
Wash slides by submerging them for 2 min in warmed RWB.
Repeat washing by submerging them again for 2 min in fresh warmed RWB.
Add drops of HRP-C1 on dried cell spots.
Incubate slides in a humidified chamber at 40°C for 15 min.
Wash slides by submerging them for 2 min in warmed RWB.
Repeat washing by submerging them again for 2 min in fresh warmed RWB.
Prepare fluorescent dye solution Opal 570 during slide submersion time.
Add drops of Opal 570 on dried cell spots.
Incubate slides in a humidified chamber at 40°C for 30 min.
Wash slides by submerging them for 2 min in warmed RWB.
Repeat washing by submerging them again for 2 min in fresh warmed RWB.
Add drops of HRP blocker on dried cell spots.
Incubate slides in a humidified chamber at 40°C for 15 min.
Wash slides by submerging them for 2 min in warmed RWB.
Repeat washing by submerging them again for 2 min in fresh warmed RWB.
Add drops of blocking buffer on dried cell spots.
Incubate slides in a humidified chamber at 20°C–23°C for 2 h.
Use 2 μg/mL concentration of antibody against SARS-CoV-2 spike protein in 100 μL per reaction.
Incubate for 16–18 h at 4°C in a humidified chamber.
Wash slides by submerging them in PBS without calcium and magnesium for 5 min under mild tangential agitation.
Repeat washing step 2×.
Add drops of secondary antibody diluted in blocking buffer (1:8000 v/v AF488-coupled goat anti-mouse IgG1 antibody) in 100 μL per reaction.
Incubate for 2 h at 20°C–23°C.
Wash slides by submerging them in PBS without calcium and magnesium for 5 min under mild tangential agitation.
Repeat washing step 2×.
Add 20 μL drops of 5 μg/mL DAPI solution in PBS without calcium and magnesium.
Wash slides by submerging them in PBS without calcium and magnesium for 5 min under mild tangential agitation on a shaking plate.
Repeat washing step 2×.
Deposit a 20 μL drop of ibidi mounting medium on the sample.
Cover it with a coverslip.
Dry at 20°C–23°C for 30 min or 16–18 h at 4°C.
Protect slides from light.
Store the prepared solutions at 4°C for up to several weeks before microscopy analysis.
Proceed to fluorescence microscopy, typically using confocal microscopy equipped with a x 60 oil immersion objective.
